arxiv-2201-00120.title: Lower bounds for moments of quadratic twisted self-dual GL ⁡ ( 3 ) \operatorname{GL}(3) central L L -values
arxiv-2201-00120.creator: Shenghao Hua and Bingrong Huang
arxiv-2201-00120.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shenghao Hua and Bingrong Huang. In this paper, we prove the conjectured order lower bound for the k k -th moment of central values of quadratic twisted self-dual GL ⁡ ( 3 ) \operatorname{GL}(3) L L -functions for all k ≥ 1 k\geq 1 , based on our recent work on the twisted first moment of central values in this family of L L -functions. Introduction

Estimating moments of central values in families of
L
-functions is an active topic of number theory.

arxiv-2209-06373.title: SEEK: model extraction attack against hybrid secure inference protocols
arxiv-2209-06373.creator: Si Chen, Junfeng Fan
arxiv-2209-06373.description: Abstract Security concerns about a machine learning model used in a prediction-as-a-service include the privacy of the model, the query and the result. Secure inference solutions based on homomorphic encryption (HE) and/or multiparty computation (MPC) have been developed to protect all the sensitive information.

arxiv-2211-02288.title: Discovery of a Mid-L Dwarf Companion to the L 262-74 System
arxiv-2211-02288.creator: Léopold Gramaize, Adam C. Schneider, Federico Marocco, Jacqueline K. Faherty, Aaron M. Meisner, J. Davy Kirkpatrick, Mark Popinchalk, Austin Rothermich, Marc J. Kuchner, The Backyard Worlds: Planet 9 Collaboration
arxiv-2211-02288.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Léopold Gramaize, Adam C. Schneider, Federico Marocco, Jacqueline K. Faherty, Aaron M. Meisner, J. Davy Kirkpatrick, Mark Popinchalk, Austin Rothermich, Marc J. Kuchner, The Backyard Worlds: Planet 9 Collaboration. We present the discovery of CWISE J151044.74 − - 524923.5, a wide low-mass companion to the nearby ( ∼ \sim 24.7 pc) system L 262-74, which was identified through the Backyard Worlds: Planet 9 citizen science project.

arxiv-2406-04460.title: Evaluating the Smooth Control of Attribute Intensity in Text Generation with LLMs
arxiv-2406-04460.creator: Shang Zhou, Feng Yao, Chengyu Dong, Zihan Wang, Jingbo ShangDepartment of Computer Science and Engineering,University of California San Diego {shz060,fengyao,cdong,ziw224,jshang}@ucsd.edu
arxiv-2406-04460.description: Abstract Controlling the attribute intensity of text generation is crucial across scenarios (e.g., writing conciseness, chatting emotion, and explanation clarity). The remarkable capabilities of large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized text generation, prompting us to explore such smooth control of LLM generation.

arxiv-2409-08535.title: Demailly’s Conjecture for general and very general points
arxiv-2409-08535.creator: Sankhaneel Bisui, Dipendranath Mahato
arxiv-2409-08535.description: Abstract . We prove that at least ( ( 1 + ϵ ) ​ 2 ​ m N − 1 + 1 + ϵ ) N \left(\dfrac{(1+\epsilon)2m}{N-1}+1+\epsilon\right)^{N} , where 0 ⩽ ϵ < 1 0\leqslant\epsilon<1 , many general points, satisfy Demailly’s conjecture.

arxiv-2502-01088.title: Study of the mass spectra of doubly heavy Ξ Q ​ Q ′ \Xi_{QQ^{\prime}} and Ω Q ​ Q ′ \Omega_{QQ^{\prime}} baryons
arxiv-2502-01088.creator: Ji-Hai Pan, Ji-Si Pan
arxiv-2502-01088.description: Abstract LHCb Collaboration first observed a doubly charmed baryon Ξ c ​ c + ⁣ + \Xi^{++}_{cc} in the Λ c + ​ K − ​ π + ​ π + \Lambda^{+}_{c}K^{-}\pi^{+}\pi^{+} decay with a mass of 3621.40 ± 0.72 ± 0.27 3621.40\pm 0.72\pm 0.27 MeV.

arxiv-2503-02479.title: Searching for mirror neutrons and dark matter with cold neutron interferometry
arxiv-2503-02479.creator: Antonio Capolupo 1, Gabriele Pisacane 1, Aniello Quaranta 2 and Francesco Romeo 1
arxiv-2503-02479.description: Abstract We report a novel neutron interferometry scheme aimed at probing the potential existence of mirror neutrons, which have been proposed as viable dark matter candidates. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that if mirror neutrons exist, ordinary neutrons would acquire a measurable geometric phase as a result of their mixing with these mirror counterparts [ 1 ] .

arxiv-2509-03140.title: Decentralised self-organisation of pivoting cube ensembles using geometric deep learning
arxiv-2509-03140.creator: Nadezhda Dobreva, Emmanuel Blazquez, Jai Grover, Dario Izzo, Yuzhen Qin, Dominik Dold, [2pt] European Space Research and Technology Centre, European Space Agency, Noordwijk, The Netherlands
arxiv-2509-03140.description: Abstract We present a decentralized model for autonomous reconfiguration of homogeneous pivoting cube modular robots in two dimensions. Each cube in the ensemble is controlled by a neural network that only gains information from other cubes in its local neighborhood, trained using reinforcement learning.

pmc-10594819.title: Effect of Kami Guibi-tang (KGT) in elderly subjects with insomnia: a study protocol from a single center, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
pmc-10594819.creator: Kyeong-Hwa Lee, Han-Gyul Lee, Seungwon Kwon, Seong-Uk Park, Woo-Sang Jung, Sang-Kwan Moon, Jung-Mi Park, Chang-Nam Ko, Seung-Yeon Cho
pmc-10594819.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundThe incidence of insomnia increases with age and is related to cognitive function in older adults; therefore, it is important to manage it actively. In this study, we report a protocol for the evaluation of the efficacy and safety of Kami Guibi-tang (KGT), a herbal prescription that has been widely used in East Asia for insomnia, forgetfulness, and depression, in older adults with insomnia.MethodsIn this single-center, double-blind, randomized controlled trial, 60 older adults with insomnia and subjective cognitive decline will be recruited

pmc-11342950.title: Self-Compassion as a Mediator Linking Sleep Disturbances with Non-Suicidal Self-Injury: A Four-Wave, Cross-Lagged Study
pmc-11342950.creator: Xuliang Shi, Miaomiao Hou, Xiaoyan Chen, Ya Zhu
pmc-11342950.description: ObjectiveThis longitudinal study examined the reciprocal relationship between sleep disturbances with non-suicidal self-injury and whether self-compassion mediates these associations.MethodsA total of 5785 freshmen were sampled from a large-scale health-related cohort among Chinese college students at the baseline. This study spanned six waves with a six-month interval between each wave.

pmc-11395590.title: Curcumin suppresses colorectal tumorigenesis through restoring the gut microbiota and metabolites
pmc-11395590.creator: Wenxin Deng, Xiaojian Xiong, Mingyang Lu, Shibo Huang, Yunfei Luo, Yujie Wang, Ying Ying
pmc-11395590.description: BackgroundCurcumin has been reported to have activity for prevention and therapy of CRC, yet its underlying mechanisms remain largely unknown. Recently, emerging evidence suggests that the gut microbiota and its metabolites contribute to the causation and progression of Colorectal cancer (CRC).

pmc-11405918.title: Targeted transcriptional downregulation of MYC using epigenomic controllers demonstrates antitumor activity in hepatocellular carcinoma models
pmc-11405918.creator: William Senapedis, Kayleigh M Gallagher, Elmer Figueroa, Jeremiah D Farelli, Robert Lyng, J Graeme Hodgson, Charles W O’Donnell, Joseph V Newman, Madison Pacaro, Stephen K Siecinski, Justin Chen, Thomas G McCauley
pmc-11405918.description: Dysregulation of master regulator c-MYC (MYC) plays a central role in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and other cancers but remains an elusive target for therapeutic intervention. MYC expression is epigenetically modulated within naturally occurring DNA loop structures, Insulated Genomic Domains (IGDs).

pmc-11435957.title: Lightweight Sewer Pipe Crack Detection Method Based on Amphibious Robot and Improved YOLOv8n
pmc-11435957.creator: Zhenming Lv, Shaojiang Dong, Jingyao He, Bo Hu, Qingyi Liu, Honghang Wang, Hui Kong
pmc-11435957.description: Aiming at the problem of difficult crack detection in underground urban sewage pipelines, a lightweight sewage pipeline crack detection method based on sewage pipeline robots and improved YOLOv8n is proposed. The method uses pipeline robots as the equipment carrier to move rapidly and collect high-definition data of apparent diseases in sewage pipelines with both water and sludge media.

pmc-11440207.creator: Qiong Wu, Yuancheng Ding, Bixiao Ding, Hao Zhu, Zhen Wu, Hao Wu
pmc-11440207.description: AbstractObjectivesTo explore the associations of air pollutants and Air Quality Index (AQI) with risk of sudden sensorineural hearing loss (SSNHL)DesignCross-sectional studySettingMedical record data and local population data collected between 2014 and 2022 in Changshu, China were retrospectively reviewed.ParticipantsAdults aged 18 years and above who were diagnosed with SSNHL in Changshu No. 1 People’s Hospital or Changshu No.

pmc-11465761.title: The therapeutic use of clonal neural stem cells in experimental Parkinson´s disease
pmc-11465761.creator: Anna Nelke, Silvia García-López, Javier R. Caso, Marta P. Pereira
pmc-11465761.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundParkinson´s disease (PD), the second most common neurodegenerative disease in the world, is characterized by the death or impairment of dopaminergic neurons (DAn) in the substantia nigra pars compacta and dopamine depletion in the striatum. Currently, there is no cure for PD, and treatments only help to reduce the symptoms of the disease, and do not repair or replace the DAn damaged or lost in PD.

pmc-11515927.title: Social Media Exposure and Other Correlates of Increased e-Cigarette Use Among Adolescents During Remote Schooling: Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11515927.creator: Vira Pravosud, Pamela M Ling, Bonnie Halpern-Felsher, Valerie Gribben, Sherif Badawy
pmc-11515927.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundLittle is known about the role of exposure to e-cigarette–related digital content, behavioral and mental health factors, and social environment on the change in adolescent e-cigarette use during COVID-19 shelter-in-place orders and remote schooling.ObjectiveThe aim of the study was to examine changes in adolescent e-cigarette use during shelter-in-place and remote schooling in association with exposure to e-cigarette–related digital content and other correlates: stronger e-cigarette dependence, feeling lonely, inability to socialize, e-cigarette use to cope with shelter-in-place, and the number of family members

pmc-11604894.title: Radiation exposure and protection advice after [177Lu]Lu-DOTA-TATE therapy in China
pmc-11604894.creator: Fei Liu, Panli Li, Junyan Xu, Jianping Zhang, Xiaoping Xu, Zhihao Chen, Ying Qiao, Yun Liang, Jie Chen, Shaoli Song
pmc-11604894.description: BackgroundWe conducted a study on radiation exposure in patients with gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasms (GEP-NENs) treated with [177Lu]Lu-DOTA-TATE in China for the first time, aiming to provide guidance and reference for radiation protection in this regard. A total of 30 GEP-NENs patients who received [177Lu]Lu-DOTA-TATE therapy were recruited in the study.

pmc-12575801.title: Silver-coated Zea mays L. nanocatalyst for efficient Azo dye photodegradation and antimicrobial applications
pmc-12575801.creator: Walaa M Abd El‐Gawad, Karim Elmaghraby, Ahmed M El-Khawaga
pmc-12575801.description: The increasing environmental issues and anticipated energy crisis highlight the urgent need for a cost-effective and efficient photocatalyst that responds to UV light for contaminant degradation. This work presents a novel approach to synthesizing Zea mays L.-loaded silver oxide nanoparticles (Ag2O) by chemically depositing a thin coating of Ag2O NPs onto the surface of Zea mays L.

pmc-13257881.title: Static Analysis of Laminated Composite Plates with Periodic Curvature Using Reissner–Mindlin Plate Theory
pmc-13257881.creator: Ozlem Vardar, Zafer Kutug, Ayse Erdolen
pmc-13257881.description: Highlights Static analysis of laminated composite plates with periodic curvature is presented.Navier solution is applied within the Reissner–Mindlin plate theory.Effects of transverse shear deformation on structural response are examined.Numerical results are validated with available analytical solutions.Benchmark results are provided for future studies on periodically curved plates.

pmc-13615788.title: Determinants of herbivory on seedlings in a subtropical forest: Insights from plant apparency, Janzen-Connell effects, and functional traits
pmc-13615788.creator: Gang Zhou, Daniel F Petticord, Yao-Zhan Xu, Yuan-Zhi Qin, Biao Dong, Xiu-Juan Qiao, Ming-Xi Jiang
pmc-13615788.description: Herbivory is widely known to play a critical role in structuring plant communities. However, much less is known about what factors determine herbivory in forest ecosystems. Here, we monitored herbivory damage on more than 2000 seedlings in a subtropical forest (2022 and 2023), to identify the key biotic drivers of interspecific variation in seedling herbivory.
